fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld) are the JSON-LD NewsArticle object spread verbatim -- a rich shape with a byline author array (each with jobTitle/url), an editor field, and a full NewsMediaOrganization publisher block. Latest-mode records (S2-atom) come from the site-wide Atom feed (not RSS 2.0: <entry>/<id>/<updated>/<content type="html"> instead of <item>/<guid>/<pubDate>/<description>). Upstream JSON-LD is passed through close to verbatim, so extra schema.org fields beyond those listed here may also appear.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest'/'latest:<section>') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-jsonld or S2-atom).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline (raw passthrough from JSON-LD NewsArticle).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text, if carried in the JSON-LD block.

author.title: Author
author.description: Byline author array, each item potentially carrying name/jobTitle/url (raw passthrough).

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Comma-separated or array of keywords, as emitted upstream.

title.title: Title
title.description: Entry title from the Atom feed (latest mode).

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL, taken from the Atom entry's <id> (latest mode).

content.title: Content (feed)
content.description: HTML article content from the Atom entry's <content type="html"> field (latest mode).

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: List of category term strings from the Atom entry (latest mode).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
